independent_unit: generated proof DAG root, conditional on one learned checkpoint

preflight.independent_unit: generated DAG root conditional on checkpoint
preflight.limits: Normal-based power is planning only. A zero-effect zero-variance pilot cannot support extrapolating a hypothetical positive effect. Root and sham independence, symmetry, readout sealing, and the scientific effect floor require independent audits. Repeated outcomes within a root are never additional worlds.

selection_exposure: First four ordinary and four OOD roots were used in a transport smoke with four training roots. Architecture and arm grid were fixed before smoke. Fresh-root readouts exclude them.
